text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Kinko Sho, my dorm 
roommate, Seeking the Pearl-san, was 
worried about how I was doing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, inexperienced as I am, I must 
work even harder... So that I can become a 
thoughtful Umamusume who hurts no one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surely, that is how a princess ought to 
be...
